identificationModule.officialTitle: Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of MC-19PD1 CAR-T in Relapsed or Refractory B Cell Lymphoma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: In this single-center, open-label, nonrandomized, no control, prospective clinical trial, appoximately 15 relapsed or refractory B-cell lymphoma patients will be enrolled. Side effects of CD19 CAR T cells therapy will be monitored. The purpose of current study is to determine the clinical efficacy and safety of CD19 CAR T cells therapy in patients with R/R B-cell lymphoma

primaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of participants with adverse events

secondaryOutcomes.description: The percentage of participants who achieved complete remission (CR) and partial remission over all participants (ORR)
